verdict.rationale: Vonage documents official client libraries for web, mobile and desktop alongside server-side SDKs. Server-generated JWT tokens grant client SDK access, and sessions and Publisher/Subscriber objects are handled by the client SDKs, which implies one backend can serve all platforms. However, the evidence never names iOS and Android SDKs specifically and never states that the session and track model is identical across them. Missing for 10: explicit iOS and Android SDK documentation, explicit statement of a shared session and track model across platform SDKs, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform parity.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: The platform includes client libraries for the web, mobile and desktop platform as well as server-side SDKs.
Server-generated Vonage Application JWT tokens grant client SDK access.
The `mediaStreamAvailable` event on Publisher and Subscriber objects automatically accounts for any changes caused by AMR
